_readme: Each entry legitimises the removal/rename of a previously-registered ACF layout slug, field name or field storage path (FLEET07). Shape: { "slug": "layout:hero" | "field:summary" | "path:group_salt_sections / hero:sections_N_heading", "version": "x.y.z release that removes it", "replacement": "new slug or null", "note": "how existing DB content is migrated" }.
